HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

2. Which response best shows understanding of Myself [? (1 mark)
   A. Say Myself [ has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself [.
   C. Apply the teaching of Myself [ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Myself [ to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

5. Which response best shows understanding of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji.
   B. Use Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

7. Which response best shows understanding of Qualities Of Enlightened Beings? (1 mark)
   A. Say Qualities Of Enlightened Beings has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Qualities Of Enlightened Beings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Qualities Of Enlightened Beings.
   D. Apply the teaching of Qualities Of Enlightened Beings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Basic Prayers? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Basic Prayers with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Basic Prayers to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Basic Prayers has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Basic Prayers.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Religious? (1 mark)
   A. Use Religious to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Religious has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious.
   D. Apply the teaching of Religious with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette:? (1 mark)
   A. Say General Etiquette: has no place in daily life.
   B. Use General Etiquette: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette:.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Basic Prayers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Qualities Of Enlightened Beings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Pranayam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Religious and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
